sources.citation: Ambrosetti, Juan B. 1896. Materiales para el estudio de las lenguas del grupo Kaingangue (Alto Paraná). Boletín de la Academia Nacional de Ciencias de Córdoba 14: 331-380 (offprint, Buenos Aires: Impr. de P. E. Coni é hijos, 1896). archive.org item materialesparael00ambr.
sources.access_detail: a copy the project holds (available on request)
sources.note: Nothing. The only Tembey material in existence is here, offprint p. 4 (= Boletín XIV p. 332; PDF page 6): a vanished tribe on the arroyo Tembey, of whose language Pedro Anzoátegui remembered only two words, 'Tupí: Puma' and 'Sepi: Carpincho'. The rest of the work is Ingain (Southern Jê) vocabularies. No phonological or prosodic remarks about Tembey are possible from two words.
